zh: 把 HH:MM 换算成从午夜开始的分钟数，问题就变成在一组整数里找严格小于当前分钟的最大值。恰好在当前时刻发车的班次不算已发出，也不需要跨到前一天。
转换所有发车时间后扫描一遍，只考虑严格小于当前分钟的班次，取其中最大的一个；它就是最近发出的一班，经过的分钟数就是两者之差。
把当前时间和每个发车时间都换算为 小时×60+分钟；last 初始为 −1，遍历发车分钟，凡是严格小于当前分钟的就用它更新 last 的最大值；若 last 仍为 −1 输出 −1，否则输出当前分钟减 last。
en: Convert HH:MM into minutes since midnight, and the task becomes finding the largest value strictly below the current minute. A bus leaving exactly at the current time has not departed yet, and there is no wrap-around to the previous day.
After converting all departures, scan them once and consider only those strictly earlier than the current minute; the largest of them is the most recent bus, and the elapsed time is the difference.

Convert the current time and every departure to hours * 60 + minutes. Start with last = -1 and, for every departure strictly smaller than the current minute, update last with the maximum. If last is still -1, print -1; otherwise print the current minute minus last.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Convert to minutes since midnight, take the largest departure minute strictly less than the current minute, and subtract.

## Correctness

The strict less-than condition exactly excludes buses that have not departed yet. Among the departed buses, the largest departure time gives the smallest elapsed time, which is the most recent bus.

## Complexity

Time O(n), extra space O(1) apart from the input.
